input.description: The location entry exactly as provided (a coordinate object is JSON-stringified).

status.description: Whether this location could be resolved and computed.

reasonCode.description: Machine-readable outcome code, e.g. OK, UNKNOWN_CITY, BAD_LATITUDE, BAD_TZID.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation, set when status is "error".

friday.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of this week's Friday.

fridayRolledForward.description: True on week 1 only, when the requested startDate was not itself a Friday and was rolled forward to the next one.

candleLighting.description: ISO 8601 timestamp WITH the location's real UTC offset (not UTC - see README). Null if include excludes "shabbat" or there is no sunset that day (see warnings).

havdalah.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with offset; may fall a day or two after Friday when Shabbat is chained to an adjacent multi-day festival.

parasha.description: Weekly Torah portion (English), when this Shabbat has one (not a festival reading).

holiday.description: Any holiday(s)/Rosh Chodesh falling Friday through the following Monday, semicolon-separated. Only computed when include contains "holidays".

zmanim.description: Friday's halachic times. Only computed when include contains "zmanim". Each field is an ISO 8601 timestamp with offset, or null (see the README for when degree-based times can be null even with a normal sunset).

warnings.description: Notable conditions, e.g. no sunrise/sunset that day (polar day/night).
